lesson.subtitle: Lesson 9 -- The Email After the Call
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 9 -- The Email After the Call

listenings.text: Okay, so, we will look at everything and get back to you. Some things are still open, I think. We will send some documents soon. Someone will check the budget. Let us talk again when we have more news.

As per our call, here are the next steps. The proposal was sent this morning. The contract will be sent by Wednesday. The budget is still pending: it has not been approved yet. We need your approval by Friday. Please acknowledge this email.

matching.title: Match the word to its meaning
defs: the formal yes that lets the work start

items.situation: You sent the proposal on Friday. One line for the email.
tips: The proposal was sent on Friday.

items.situation: They have not approved the budget. One line, no blame.
tips: The budget has not been approved yet.

items.situation: Your team finished an onboarding two days early. One line, active.
tips: We completed the onboarding two days early.

items.situation: A long email arrived. You cannot answer today. One line.
tips: Just acknowledging receipt. A full answer follows on Monday.

items.situation: Ask them to quote the reference number. One line.
tips: Please quote the reference number in any reply.

arguebank.label: Useful language
items: B is polite but I still don't know ...
It doesn't say who does what.
A tells me what to do in thirty seconds.
"At your disposal" means nothing on its own.
The passive here is not cold, it is ...
What is missing from B is ...
I'd have to call them to understand it.
